answer: Seal every output in an onyx vault: an append-only record where duplicate content hashes void both copies, so clones cannot paste one result a thousand times. Each epoch a karst audit dissolves a random slice of attestations and demands re-proof from scratch, and a zephyr shuffle reassigns every identity to a new audit committee, so no farm can hide under a friendly panel. One honest agent re-proves once; a thousand clones each face their own re-proof.
